scope: Fail closed on missing, excess, duplicate, nonpositive, or non-finite physical TABLE row-height/column-width values without confusing them with title/header/data style-height overrides.

fields.141: One repeated physical row-height value per row
fields.142: One repeated physical column-width value per column

implementation.behavior: DRW_Table retains one finite positive group-141/group-142 value per declared row/column. Excess values mark the record semantically incomplete; finalization also marks missing values and groups consumed before their dimensions are known incomplete. Non-finite numeric spellings are rejected by the DXF reader. Group 140 title/header/data style-height mapping remains separate.
implementation.preservation: Incomplete TABLE records remain readable where the numeric syntax is valid; the change does not enable broader TABLE output profiles.

generatedControls.source: TABLE tags authored in memory by the existing focused test; no fixture file added.
cases: valid one-row/one-column baseline remains semantically complete
missing group 141 or 142 marks the table incomplete
excess/duplicate group 141 or 142 marks the table incomplete
zero and negative row heights/column widths mark the table incomplete
NaN and infinity row heights/column widths are rejected during import

limitations: Generated parser-integrity evidence only; no independent producer or native rendering qualification.
Noncanonical group order before row/column counts is refused by incomplete semantic disposition rather than buffered and reconstructed.
No writer support or general TABLE support claim follows.
